profile and hotkey report
- approximated profile "Recording audio tracks": OBS recorded several audio tracks; RBS records the mix on one track.
- approximated profile "Recording format": OBS's fragmented or hybrid file became a plain file of that container.
- skipped profile "Stream sign-in": The server's user name is not in RBS and was not read.
- skipped profile "Stream sign-in": The server's password is not in RBS and was not read.
- approximated setting "Audio channels": RBS mixes in stereo.
- skipped hotkey "OBSBasic.StopStreaming": RBS has one shortcut that starts and stops, so only the OBSBasic.StartStreaming hotkey was used.
- skipped hotkey "OBSBasic.Transition": RBS has no command for this hotkey yet.
- skipped hotkey "ReplayBuffer.Save": The key is a mouse button.
